notes: 0.3.52：面板「插件数据与额外路径」卡改成和「同步内容」一致的手势——先是只读（开关、单文件上限、排除名单、额外路径都锁着），点「修改」才解锁：额外路径可以直接在页面填绝对路径点「添加」、点「移除」删掉；改完点「保存」才写进 config-sync-extra.json，点「取消」丢弃改动。填相对路径会被当场拦下（换台机器对不上）。
notesEn: 0.3.52: the "Plugin data & extra paths" card now uses the same gesture as "Sync content" — read-only first (switches, per-file cap, exclusion list and extra paths all locked), and Edit unlocks it: you can add an absolute path right there and click Remove to delete one; Save writes config-sync-extra.json, Cancel drops the change. A relative path is rejected on the spot (it would not line up on the other machine).
